author: cms-sw
body:
### Summary of changes

- **Update PyTorch stack to v2.14.1**
  - Update `torch`, `torch-cuda` and `torch-rocm` from `2.13.0` to `2.14.1`.
  - Update `torchvision` to `0.29.1`.
  - Update ROCm builds of `torch-cluster`, `torch-scatter` and `torch-sparse` from `post6` to `post7`.

- **Update numerical computing and scientific Python packages**
  - Update `numpy` to `2.5.4`, `pandas` to `3.0.6`, `awkward` to `2.14.0` and `awkward-cpp` to `57`.
  - Update `scikit-learn` to `1.9.1`, `networkx` to `3.7` and `scikit-build-core` to `1.1.1`.
  - Update `matplotlib` to `3.11.2`, `boost-histogram` to `1.8.1`, `hist` to `2.12.0` and `vector` to `1.9.0`.
  - Update `onnx` to `1.23.2`, `orjson` to `3.13.0` and `pydantic` to `2.14.1`.

- **Update machine learning and AI dependencies**
  - Update `jax` and `jaxlib` to `0.11.2`.
  - Update `huggingface-hub` to `2.2.0` and `timm` to `1.0.30`.
  - Update `google-auth` to `2.62.0` and `google-auth-oauthlib` to `1.5.0`.
  - Update `nvidia-ml-py` to `13.615.71`.

- **Update TensorFlow-related and data-processing dependencies**
  - Update `protobuf` to `7.36.2`, `grpcio` and `grpcio-tools` remain at `1.83.1`.
  - Update `blosc2` to `4.14.1`, `cramjam` to `2.14.0`, `msgpack` to `1.2.3` and `uproot` to `5.7.7`.

- **Update Jupyter and notebook packages**
  - Update `ipykernel` to `7.4.0`, `jupyter-server` to `2.21.1` and `jupyterlab-server` to `2.28.1`.
  - Update `notebook` to `7.6.3` and `nbconvert` to `7.17.2`.

- **Update Python build, packaging and development tools**
  - Update `conan` to `2.33.0`, `poetry` to `2.5.1` and `poetry-core` to `2.5.0`.
  - Update `meson` to `1.12.1`, `meson-python` to `0.22.1`, `flit` and `flit-core` to `4.1.0`, and `hatchling` to `1.32.4`.
  - Update `virtualenv` to `21.14.7`, `filelock` to `4.1.1` and `setuptools-scm` to `10.3.4`.
  - Update linting and code-analysis tools, including `flake8`, `pylint`, `pyflakes`, `pycodestyle` and `isort`.

- **Update general-purpose libraries and utilities**
  - Refresh numerous dependencies, including `aiohttp`, `anyio`, `astroid`, `coverage`, `cryptography` (unchanged at `50.0.1`), `dulwich`, `lxml`, `Markdown`, `pillow` (unchanged at `12.3.0`), `requests` (unchanged at `2.34.2`), `scipy` (unchanged at `1.18.1`) and `urllib3` (unchanged at `2.8.0`).
  - Update supporting libraries for serialization, networking, compression, validation and Python packaging.

- **Add `iminuit` v2.33.0** and update the existing pinned PyPI package versions in `pip/requirements.txt`, while retaining packages explicitly held by local compatibility constraints.
title: Pytorch 2.14.1 and massive update of python packages
